homework_done.name: Homework done
homework_done.description: Marks today's homework as done for a child, which unlocks the after-homework period. Unlocks: parent code required from a non-admin account.

add_bonus.name: Add bonus
add_bonus.description: Adds bonus minutes for today to a child or to a resource (exactly one of the two). Unlocks: parent code required from a non-admin account.

exception.name: Manual exception
exception.description: Forces a resource, a child or a service open or closed. Returns the exception id. Opening requires the parent code from a non-admin account; closing never does.

open.name: Open
open.description: On to open, off to close.

service.name: Service
service.description: Id of one of your services (Rules panel, General tab).

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Duration (1 to 240 minutes). Empty: until the next scheduled change.

code.name: Parent code
code.description: Required from a non-admin account to open.

cancel_exception.name: Cancel exception
cancel_exception.description: Removes a manual exception. Cancelling a closure re-opens and requires the parent code from a non-admin account.

exception_id.name: Exception id
exception_id.description: Id returned by the exception action.

code.name: Parent code
code.description: Required from a non-admin account when cancelling a closure.

start_timer.name: Start timer
start_timer.description: Starts a screen-time timer for a child during a quota period, capped to the remaining quota. Unlocks: parent code required from a non-admin account.

stop_timer.name: Stop timer
stop_timer.description: Stops the running timer of a child. No code required.

pause.name: Pause
pause.description: Global pause: closes every resource immediately. Ending the pause requires the parent code from a non-admin account.

active.name: Active
active.description: On to pause, off to resume.

code.name: Parent code
code.description: Required from a non-admin account to resume.

import_config.name: Import configuration
import_config.description: Replaces the whole configuration (kids, resources, schedules). Administrators only.

request.name: Request time
request.description: A child asks the parents for time. No code required: a parent must answer from the notification. Returns the request id.

service.name: Service
service.description: Id of one of your services (Rules panel, General tab) (optional).

options.name: Options
options.description: Durations offered to the parents (null: until the next change).

replace.name: Replaces
replace.description: Exception identifiers to replace when accepted.
